_comment: The three *qps profiles above gate scripts/perf_test.sh. Since F-017 was fixed (DD-021), max_p95_latency_ms is compared against a real p95 over every request, failed ones included. Before, it was compared against the average of successful requests, and the thresholds were set loose to allow for that; they have not been re-measured since. The bench_standard bounds below come from bench/run.sh, which measures real percentiles from every observation.

bench_standard._comment: Regression bounds for ./bench/run.sh --scale standard. Empty until a standard-scale run has been performed on a named reference machine; GRVX-1001 measures, and a threshold set from a single unreviewed run is not a baseline.

bench_standard_measured._comment: What the reference machine measured, recorded beside the bounds rather than as them. GRVX-1005 asks for the achieved throughput and p99 here. The bounds above stay empty until perf-cost-engineer reviews more than one standard-scale run; tests/governance TestIngestThroughputTarget checks the target against the committed result.
